weekendPlanner.title: Sorrento Solstice weekend: fire, music, and the Peninsula at full winter volume
weekendPlanner.dek: The winter solstice festival lands on the Sorrento foreshore Saturday. Truffle hunts, hot springs, and the quiet Sunday that follows.

cards.title: Sorrento Solstice Festival, Sorrento Foreshore
cards.note: Free winter festival on the foreshore: two music stages, fire performers, lantern path, food trucks, and the 6-metre 'Bernie' effigy burn on the bay at 6:30pm. Free ticketed — book via Humanitix. The Peninsula's biggest winter night.

cards.title: Red Hill Truffles, winter truffle hunt, Main Ridge
cards.note: Périgord black season is in full swing. Pizza hunts from $189pp, lunch bundles from $195pp, private hunts from $120pp minimum. The solstice weekend booking window is still available. Booking required.

cards.title: Peninsula Hot Springs Sunday Sessions, Rye
cards.note: Live music every Sunday afternoon from the amphitheatre pool stage. Included with afternoon bathing session — no separate ticket. The post-solstice Sunday reset. Runs through 28 June.

cards.title: Flinders Truffles winter hunt, Flinders
cards.note: Guided Périgord black truffle hunts on the Flinders farm through winter. Truffle soup and toastie by the fire after the hunt. Farmgate days run without booking. A quieter Sunday alternative to the Solstice crowds.
